turns.speaker: calltaker
turns.text: Emergency services, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please hurry, my father collapsed and he is not breathing

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We are on Hamdan Street, building 14, second floor

turns.speaker: calltaker
turns.text: Stay on the line. How old is he?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He is sixty eight years old. He had chest pain and then fell, he is unconscious

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, just him. There are two of us here, me and my mother
